_note: Voice-note replay corpus for stream U (docs/88 A point 6) and the future voice suite (proposed gate P7-G1). Each case is a transcript a provider could return for a customer's voice note. The test sends the same words once typed and once as a voice note and requires HQ to treat them identically: same text, same untrusted provenance, same thread state, same hand-over. No real audio; the audio bytes are generated per case.
